$comment: The places table of hero landmarks (house kit K10, world QA W-27 and L-04). Each entry names a point and the collider records the pipeline tags meta.landmark with the entry's id: tagged records are drawn with no office window grid (glazing 0) in the entry's material, with no ground-floor shop band, and storefront anchors on them are not drawn unless storefronts is true. A model in content/landmarks.json with the same id replaces the records when it lands; until then the tagged records are the documented interim shape. A building entry's point is a probe: it lies inside its first record, and resolving it the way the pipeline resolves areas.json probes (records containing the point, a podium's tower with it) gives exactly the listed records and their towers (src/content/landmarkTags.ts resolveProbe; tests/content/landmark-tags.test.ts checks it on the committed sf world). A site entry (records empty) is a landmark with no footprint record (a gate over a street, ruins at the shore): its point stands in no footprint. Labels avoid the pre-release legal checklist names; the notes give the real names for the reader.

stone.note: Granite and grey sandstone civic buildings.

brick.note: Red brick with stone or concrete trim.

landmarks.label: The Ferry Building and its clock tower
landmarks.note: The world origin. Its model replaces the records; the market hall keeps its storefront anchors (market stalls, icons only, docs/design.md territory step 1). Clock tower 245 ft.

landmarks.label: The pyramid tower at 600 Montgomery St
landmarks.note: The Transamerica Pyramid, a pre-release legal checklist name: player text says the pyramid tower. White precast quartz cladding, 853 ft.

landmarks.label: Coit Tower on Telegraph Hill
landmarks.note: Unpainted pale concrete column, 210 ft. The gift shop inside is not a street storefront.

landmarks.label: The twin-spired church on the north side of Washington Square
landmarks.note: Saints Peter and Paul Church, 666 Filbert St (built 1924; the roll says 1922). L-04: pipeline/areas.json probes it at 37.8003,-122.4104, by Union St at the south edge of Washington Square, about 140 m south of the church, which resolves to 201006.0003946 (a 1914 apartment building 9.1 m away; the point is in no record). This point is 5.2 m inside 201006.0001265 (16.5 m before the regenerated world terraced the church into the main record and four strips, -s1..-s4, pieceOf it and tagged with it), whose -tower record is the spires (57.8 m tall). Twin spires 191 ft.

landmarks.label: The Palace of Fine Arts rotunda
The three-legged radio tower on Mount Sutro
landmarks.note: Sutro Tower, a pre-release legal checklist name. The records are the LiDAR's plan view of the lattice and its base buildings, held at 3 m plinths until the model replaces them (W-25). 977 ft.

landmarks.label: City Hall and its dome, Civic Center
landmarks.note: Granite; dome 307.5 ft. Loses the shop band it is drawn with today (house kit K5).

landmarks.label: The cathedral on Nob Hill
landmarks.note: Grace Cathedral: grey concrete cast to read as stone, twin towers on the facade.

landmarks.label: Mission Dolores and the basilica beside it
landmarks.note: White mud-brick and stucco; keeps its 39 m bell tower record. Loses the shop band it is drawn with today (house kit K5). Hallucination Tour and audio-guide lines here are about objects and infrastructure only (docs/design.md, Places).

landmarks.label: The Conservatory of Flowers, Golden Gate Park
landmarks.note: White-painted timber and glass greenhouse. The interim draws it without an office window grid; the model brings the glass.

landmarks.label: The ballpark at China Basin
landmarks.note: Unnamed in the game (docs/design.md territory step 3): its naming-rights name is a brand. Red brick; the street-facing concession anchors stay.

landmarks.label: The Dutch windmill at the west end of Golden Gate Park
landmarks.note: The Dutch Windmill (1903), drawn today as a 13.4 m box with a 35.5 m tower and windows.

landmarks.label: Fort Point under the bridge's south end
landmarks.note: Brick and granite fort, about 15 m tall. Its 64.6 m -tower record is a LiDAR phantom that Pipeline drops (W-16); the tag covers the fort and any tower or piece of it.

landmarks.label: The gate over Grant Ave at Bush St
landmarks.note: The Dragon Gate, the south entrance to Chinatown: a prop that stands over the street (Assets). No mechanic or joke treats Chinatown as a source or route of anything (docs/design.md, Places).

landmarks.label: The bath-house ruins at Lands End
landmarks.note: The Sutro Baths ruins: low concrete walls and pools at the shore, a prop (Assets).

provenance.review: Pending: written in the world QA round (W-27, L-04); a second agent session reads it against the docs/ai-layer.md checklist.
